auditBasis: Current KO/EN/JA article text, repository references and visual inspection of the nine Photo Art assets with previously missing source URLs. Live public Photo Art pages and their displayed JPEGs were checked on 2026-10-03; all nine source JPEGs are byte-identical to the corresponding local JPGs, with matching SHA-256 hashes. This verifies public publication sources only, not original authorship, acquisition history or reuse permission. The two existing non-Photo Art sources were not independently reverified in this follow-up. Reviewed flags record this audit, not clearance.
